answer: An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 4 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Because the fable count is verified against the wander text itself, the signal audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 190 aliases thus means producing 190 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. That is 4 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
